title: Managed Database: native retention allocation — residual entitlement
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following residual entitlement basis. Subtract the completed external allocation from measured retained quantity and floor that remainder at zero.

## Remainder case
Hypothetical inputs: measured retained quantity is 12 GB-month and completed external allocation is 15 GB-month. Subtraction gives a negative remainder, so the retained remainder is zero.
